signal: Points North continues expanding its ACA Reporter compliance software, including a Next Generation integration with ADP Workforce Now and industry-specific solutions for agriculture and brokers

email.subject1: a signal play for Points North
email.body1:
Megan, saw Points North is expanding ACA Reporter with the ADP Workforce Now Next Generation integration and new industry-specific solutions.

Widening into more industries usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Points North off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Megan, quick follow-up for Points North.

More segments to sell into usually raise the pipeline bar faster than headcount can follow. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Points North needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Megan, last bit of proof for Points North.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Points North's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Megan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding across new industries is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Points North either way.
